sources.snippet: 1pp-2.81b-v2-asst-rawanneal-seed1234-sft One Persona Pretraining (1PP) scaling-ladder model: 2.81B parameters, pretraining condition original documents, then rewritten conversations, assistant-turn loss in the cooldown, seed 1234, followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

sources.title: Raghav-Singhal/1pp-2.81b-v2-asst-sft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Part of ladder v2: four sizes (0.58B, 0.98B, 1.66B, 2.81B) × three conditions × three seeds (28, 42, 1234), each size trained from scratch for 20.3 assistant tokens per parameter on the same step-aligned data stream. Conditions differ only in the document text and the loss mask; seeds differ only in the parameter initialization (the batch order is the same). The 1.66B rung is the 1.7B model ...
